messages:
Asha: RSM requested end-to-end evidence for KMS rotations, grant lifecycle, and RBAC drift covering multi-region keys + HSM/External-KMS integrations for SOC 2. They want a compact machine-readable bundle, redaction notes, and short narratives per rotation. Deadline COB Friday.
Ben: We can assemble: CloudTrail rotate/update events, grant create/delete events, git diffs for infra/kms policies, EKM/HSM audit logs (timestamped key wrap/unwarp), IAM role-policy snapshots, and IRSA/serviceaccount mappings. Will also include smoke test decrypt logs.
Auditor_RSM: Please include: (1) rotation timestamps and approvers (pseudonym OK), (2) grant lifecycle (grantId, createdBy, create/delete times), (3) principals with decrypt/GenerateDataKey permissions before and after each change, (4) any linkages to incident tickets that triggered rotations, (5) evidence that post-rotation decrypts succeeded. A short narrative (200-400 chars) per rotation is helpful. No key material.
Asha: Plan: 1) export CloudTrail events for CreateKey/RotateKey/UpdateKeyPolicy/CreateGrant for the last 120 days. 2) export EKM/HSM audit logs for keywrap operations and admin sessions. 3) produce policy diffs from infra repo for kms-policies. 4) IAM snapshot and IRSA mapping. 5) manifest.csv + redaction_map + sha256 checksums. 6) deliver bundle + secure SFTP for identity mapping.
Ben: Quick CLI examples: 
```
# CloudTrail rotate events
aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventName,AttributeValue=RotateKey \
  --start-time 2026-12-01T00:00:00Z --end-time 2027-03-01T00:00:00Z --query 'Events' > ct_rotate_120d.json
# List grants for key
aws kms list-grants --key-id arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111222333:key/abcd-rot > grants_key_abcd.json
# EKM/HSM audit (example operator note)
# (exported from onprem HSM appliance as hsm_audit_20270215.log)
```
Ben: For IAM scan I fetch roles, then policy docs and grep for kms:Decrypt or kms:GenerateDataKey. I also crosswalk IRSA annotations to assume-role ARNs and capture deployment names.
Auditor_RSM: In addition to role ARNs, please annotate any short-lived credentials (STS tokens, AssumeRole sessions) that granted decrypt rights. We may request the session id audit if it appears in CloudTrail.
Asha: Noted. We'll include a sessions.csv with AssumeRole/session create events filtered for kms actions. Also capturing any EKM proxy calls showing key wrap/unwrap timestamps.
Ben: Example manifest row we'll include (CSV):
artifact_type,source,created_at,evidence_file,sha256,redacted
cloudtrail,aws,2027-02-15T14:12:03Z,ct_rotate_20270215.json,6f1ed002ab5595859014ebf0951522d9,false
Asha: There's an emergency rotation on 2027-02-02 for key arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:777888999:key/hsm-proxy-01 after an HSM firmware vuln triage (ticket SEC-191). Include ticket link, EKM audit logs (hsm_wrap_20270202.log), and post-rotation smoke test (smoke_decrypt_20270202.log).
Auditor_RSM: Please pseudonymize approver names as approver:<id> and provide identity_map via secure SFTP. We may ask for attestations for any redactions. Also include the SOP pointer for HSM-EKM failover and who can authorize emergency rotations.
Ben: evidence_bot kicking off bundle job now with tags: kms,rbac,hsm,ekm,soc2.
evidence_bot: bundle-job-1809999999 queued. ETA ~4m. :package: 
Ben: We'll also include a redaction_map.csv that shows fields replaced and the replacement format (employee:<id>). For role ARNs we will keep full ARNs per auditor guidance.
Asha: Once bundle is ready I'll draft the cover email with manifest, sha256, redaction notes, secure SFTP instructions for identity_map, and a short narrative per rotation. Any objections?
Auditor_RSM: No objections. We'll validate the bundle and may request a short walkthrough on EKM logs mapping to the key rotation for one rotated key.
evidence_bot: bundle-job-1809999999 completed: https://s3.internal.company/evidence/1809999999_kms_hsm_bundle.tar.gz :lock: sha256: f2ca1bb6c7e907d06dafe4687e579fce
Ben: Uploaded: ct_rotate_120d.json, grants_key_abcd.json, hsm_wrap_20270202.log, policy-diff.patch, roles_kms_snapshot.csv, irsa_map.csv, sessions.csv, redaction_map.csv, manifest.csv, smoke_decrypt_20270202.log
Asha: Drafting narratives now. Example narrative (rot-20270202): "Emergency rotation performed after HSM firmware CVE triage (SEC-191). Approved by approver:234 per emergency SOP. Rotation executed via EKM proxy; post-rotation smoke decrypts for critical workloads succeeded. Associated ticket: SEC-191."
Ben: I'll hold a 20-min walkthrough tomorrow at 10am PT if the auditor wants to review the EKM/keywrap trace.
Auditor_RSM: Received bundle link, starting validation. We'll ping for the EKM walkthrough if needed. Thanks for the thorough manifest.
Asha: Thanks team. Closing after auditor confirms. :white_check_mark:
